# javaabu/forms

> Laravel Blade components (`<x-forms::…>`) for forms, listing pages and details pages, with model binding, old input and validation errors. Renders for Onu (Tailwind with @javaabu/onu's classes, the default) or Bootstrap 6. Same components and attributes as the React package @javaabu/forms. Dhivehi and RTL built in.

Paths are relative to this file. In a project, that's vendor/javaabu/forms/.

## Rules

- Build forms and admin views with the components (`<x-forms::text>`, `<x-forms::select2>`, `<x-forms::submit>`, `<x-forms::table>`, …); don't write form HTML or Onu/Bootstrap classes by hand. Extra classes go in `class` (the control) or `form-group-class` (the wrapper).
- Bind the model once, on `<x-forms::form :model="$model">` or with `@model($model) … @endmodel`. Never write `value="{{ old(...) }}"`: old input, the model and `default` are applied for you.
- `name` gives the id (`address[city]` → `address-city`), the label (`first_name` → `First Name`, through `__()`), the bound value and the error key (`address.city`). Pass `label` for a different label; don't translate `name`.
- Errors show under each field by themselves; add `summary` to the form for a list at the top. Don't add `@error` blocks next to fields.
- Attributes are kebab-case; pass PHP values with `:` (`:options="$islands"`). Options are `[value => label]` arrays, collections or Eloquent queries.
- Colours use Bootstrap's names in both frameworks: `color="danger"`, `color="outline-secondary"`, `type="success"` (alerts).
- Free-text fields that hold Dhivehi get `thaana`. All user-facing text goes through `__()` with a Dhivehi translation.
- JavaScript and CSS load through javaabu/manifest. Don't add jQuery, Select2, flatpickr or js-utilities. Keep `@stack('scripts')` in the layout for Google Maps and TinyMCE.
- Choose the framework in `config/forms.php` (`FORMS_FRAMEWORK`), not per view.
- To change markup, publish one view with `php artisan forms:publish-view`.
